text:
alana - product: Quick sync — I'm drafting the PRD for launch gating around encryption + audit logs for SOC2/ISO. Primary asks: KMS vs HSM options, retention defaults, export/immutable log requirements, and acceptance criteria. Goal: finalize scope for the next roadmap cut.

mike - security: +1. We need explicit requirements for customer-managed keys (BYOK), HSM-backed keys for certain enterprise tiers, key rotation policy, and key access audit trails. Also call out dual-control for key deletion.

jess - eng-infra: For logs: plan to support configurable retention per-tenant, default 365 days but configurable to 7/30/90/365 and infinite for archived. Need to decide export paths (S3 with encryption, Splunk, BigQuery). Implementation note: retention enforced by lifecycle job; have to support legal-hold to override deletion.

raouf - sre: Can we also list edge cases: partial export failures, replays for forensics, accidental PI leaks in logs — need masking/pseudonymization hooks before export. Cost note: 365 days at current ingestion rates ~ +20% infra spend for logs.

sara - legal: SOC2 wants immutable, tamper-evident audit trails. ISO wants evidence of retention policy and proof of regular backups. Legal/Compliance prefers retention default of 1 year with ability to extend; any deletion must be logged and approved. Also require customer-facing SLA language around access to their audit exports.

mike - security: Acceptance criteria proposal (short):
- Customers can choose service-managed KMS or BYOK (customer KMS) in console/API.
- HSM-backed keys available for Dedicated/Private and Enterprise tiers.
- All crypto ops logged with key_id, caller, operation, timestamp; logs immutable for retention window.
- Deletion of cryptographic keys must require dual-approval and is recorded in an immutable audit entry.
- Audit exportable to S3/Splunk with end-to-end encryption and optional PII masking.

jess - eng-infra: Implementation sketch (config snippet):
```yaml
audit: 
  retention_days: 365  # default
  export_targets: ["s3", "splunk"]
  legal_hold: false
```
We also need an admin API: `POST /v1/tenants/:id/audit/export` that kicks off a signed archive for download.

alana - product: Edge cases to call out in PRD:
- Tenant sets retention < regulatory minimum (deny/require higher).
- Export job partial success (some files failed): must surface clear status and retry window.
- Customer provides a KMS key that doesn't support required ops (warn & fallback).
- HSM provisioning delay for Dedicated onboarding (estimate 3-5 business days).

raouf - sre: Operational acceptance checks:
- Daily integrity checks (hash chain) over audit files.
- Alert if retention enforcement/cleanup job fails >1 hour.
- Test playbook for key compromise: rotate, revoke, re-encrypt and run end-to-end audit export.

sara - legal: Add to acceptance criteria: immutable retention proof (signed manifests) and exportable chain-of-custody docs for ISO audits.

mike - security: Also: define minimal log schema for crypto events so downstream tools can parse reliably. Include `event_type`, `key_id`, `actor`, `ip`, `result`, `raw_payload_hash`.

alana - product: This is great. Next steps: mike/jess to consolidate a 1-page acceptance criteria block + sample API/console flows; sara to add legal text for PRD; raouf to write SRE runbook bullets. Can we get that by EOW (Fri)?

jess - eng-infra: I'll draft the API and retention lifecycle doc and add perf/cost estimates. ETA: Thu EOD.

mike - security: I'll produce the acceptance criteria + minimal schema. ETA: Thu.

sara - legal: I'll add the audit wording and retention justification. ETA: Fri AM.

deploy-bot: New PRD draft created: https://docs.internal/prd/kms-audit-retention (draft)

alana - product: Thanks all — once we have the one-pager I'll update roadmap board and flag for PM sync on Monday. Please add obvious edge cases you think of. :thumbsup:
